subject: Pilot cost recap + invoice sketch for Spiral AI — token economics clarification
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@spiral.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot cost recap + invoice sketch for Spiral AI — token economics clarification

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet today. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can get an accurate invoice sketch over to you: several bullets below.

Call summary:
- Pilot scope: evaluate Q&A and summarization flows integrated into Spiral’s support app; read-only data path, no PII in prompts.
- Expected steady-state consumption: ~50M tokens / month (inference tokens) once integrated.
- Spike/batch jobs: occasional nightly batch runs that could temporarily add up to 150–200M tokens on peak days (we recommend autoscaling + burst policy).
- Latency SLO: 300–600ms p95 for single-turn queries; streaming not required initially.

Cost/price context we discussed on the call:
- You're looking for a target effective price around $X/1M tokens (you mentioned wanting <$1k/1M but unsure of exact boundary).
- Invoice cadence: monthly; you'll want line items for committed capacity vs on-demand burst.

Ask: can you confirm the expected month-1 steady volume (pick a band: 30–40M, 40–60M, or 60–80M)? Also confirm whether Spiral can commit to a 6-month pilot/PO (we can extend a credit/discount for commitments).

Next steps from Redwood:
- Attached a baseline costing workbook (spiral-pilot-costing.xlsx) and our token calculator (redwood-token-calculator.csv) so you can see assumptions and per-model unit rates.
- I’ll put together two invoice sketches: (A) committed-pilot pricing with a lower $/1M and (B) burst/on-demand-first pricing with higher unit cost and an optional intro credit.
- If those look fine, we’ll produce a short DocuSign-ready estimate and schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to lock terms.

Attachments:
- spiral-pilot-costing.xlsx (Excel) — baseline volumes, month-by-month proforma, and model mix assumptions.
- redwood-token-calculator.csv (CSV) — simple token math and effective $/1M outputs.

Thanks — if you want me to bake in any specific model types (e.g., 8k vs 32k context runs) mention that and we’ll reflect it.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@spiral.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hargrove <tom.h@spiral.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Pilot cost recap + invoice sketch for Spiral AI — token economics clarification

Thanks Dylan — helpful recap. Quick answers:

- Month-1 expected steady volume: realistically 30–45M tokens (we’ll likely be at the low end while we validate).
- Peak/batch: yes, could spike to ~120–150M on heavy ingestion days, but not sustained.
- Budget range: for the pilot we have budgeted approximately $25k–$35k / month.
- Commitment: Spiral can commit to a 3-month pilot PO right now; longer commitment depends on results.
- Compliance question: we need clarification on KMS key usage and whether logs with token-level metadata are stored. Can you loop in a security contact or point me to a short doc?

If you can provide two sketches (a 3-month committed pilot with tiered pricing and a no-commitment on-demand plan) that would help our finance team decide. Also include any available intro credits or trial subsidies you can offer.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Moore
Head of Product, Spiral AI

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 20:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Pilot cost recap + invoice sketch for Spiral AI — internal pricing options

Internal — quick pricing options to feed into the reply:

Option 1 — Committed pilot (recommended if they can commit 3 months):
- Commitment: 50M tokens / month (3-month PO)
- Unit rate: $950 / 1M tokens
- Effective monthly: $47,500 (discounts on model mix included)
- Pilot credit: we can apply $10,000 credit spread across first invoice (margin hit but helps close).

Option 2 — Low-commitment / burst-first:
- On-demand unit: $1,250 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Burst protection: first 150M tokens of burst billed at $750/1M up to a capped amount for the first 30 days (intro offer)
- No upfront PO required; monthly invoicing only.

Notes:
- For Spiral’s $25k–$35k budget we should show how their sample volume bands map to effective monthly spend for each option.
- I’ll draft a quick invoice sketch (PDF) and mark the pilot credit so Dylan can share.

Vanessa
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@spiral.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 02:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pilot cost recap + invoice sketch for Spiral AI — token economics clarification

Alyssa — thanks for the quick answers and the budget band. Attached is an updated estimate (Spiral_Redwood_Estimate_20270727_v2.pdf) that lays out the two options Vanessa proposed plus a short month-by-month proforma that maps your 30–45M band to actual expected spend.

Recap of the two options included in the PDF:
- Committed 3-month pilot: 50M @ $950/1M -> effective $47.5k/mo before credit. With our $10k pilot credit applied in month 1, month-1 payable would be ~$37.5k.
- On-demand/burst-first: baseline on-demand $1,250/1M with an intro burst discount for the first 30 days that effectively reduces the first-month unit to ~$850/1M for the first 150M tokens.

Security note: Karthik, can you paste the short KMS/logs note here for Alyssa? If you prefer I can loop in Security directly but a 1–2 line assurance would help (and we’ll follow with SOC2 artifact link).

Next steps:
- Confirm which option you want sketched into a DocuSign estimate and I’ll send that today (link included).
- If you want a 30-min follow-up to walk the PDF with finance, pick a time and I’ll calendar.

DocuSign (estimate draft): https://docusign.example.com/abc123
Attachments:
- Spiral_Redwood_Estimate_20270727_v2.pdf (PDF) — invoice sketch and month-by-month proforma.

Thanks —
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
